states.new: All prior requirements have been met and no obligation is currently pending: no client is waiting to have an order taken, no taken order is waiting for preparation, no prepared food is waiting to be served, and no fallen food needs an immediate pickup. This is the clean baseline for handling new events. The agent should continue taking a client's order when one arrives, preparing food after an order is taken, serving prepared food, and picking up food on the very next step if it slips.
states.old: Nothing is pending: no client has been left waiting for attention, no prepared food has been promised to a client, and no fallen food is awaiting pickup. From here the work is to respond to whatever comes next: a newly arrived client must have their order taken, fetched food must eventually be prepared and served, and any fallen food must be picked up on the very next step.

states.new: An order has been taken but its food has not yet been prepared. The next obligation is to prepare that food at the stove; once it is prepared, it will still need to be served. If the food slips before preparation, recovering it on the very next step becomes an additional immediate duty.
states.old: An order has been taken, so that client is waiting and the taken order must still be followed by preparing food at the stove and then serving it. The order of fetching and preparing remains to be done. If food slips during this work, it must be picked up on the immediately following step.

states.new: Food has been prepared and must still be served. The agent should deliver it to the client to discharge that obligation. If the food slips now, it must first be picked up on the very next step, and the serving duty remains afterward.
states.old: The carried food has been prepared at the stove, so it must still be delivered to the waiting client. Because a client's order was necessarily taken before preparation, that client is still owed a serve. Any slip during this errand must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: Food has just slipped and no other order or preparation duty is pending. The agent must pick the food up on the very next step; if that step ends without food in hand, the failure is irreversible. This is an immediate one-step deadline.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while an order was already taken, so the client's order still needs preparing and serving. Picking the fallen food back up on the very next step is required, and failing to do so ends the task in failure.

states.new: An order has been taken and still needs its food prepared, and food has just slipped out of the agent's hands. The agent must regain food on the very next step or fail irreversibly. If the pickup succeeds, the earlier preparation obligation remains.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands and an order is outstanding, so the client still needs preparation and serving of food. The slip must be answered by picking the food back up on the very next step; leaving the hands empty then makes success impossible.

states.new: Prepared food has slipped, so the agent must pick it up on the very next step or fail the immediate-pickup requirement. If it is recovered in time, the prepared food still needs to be served.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while food was already prepared, so the prepared portion must be regained and delivered to the client. The fallen food must be picked up on the immediately next step, or the task fails for good.

states.new: A client is waiting and their order has not yet been taken. This obligation can persist while the agent does other things or delays, but the client will remain until served. Taking the order is the immediate objective; afterward preparation and serving still have to follow. If food slips while the order is still untaken, an additional next-step pickup duty appears.
states.old: A client has just arrived and their order has not been taken yet. The immediate job is to take that order, after which food must be fetched, prepared at the stove and served; any slip along the way must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: Two obligations are pending: a waiting client's order has not been taken, and prepared food is waiting to be served. The agent must both take the waiting client's order and serve the prepared food. Progress on either obligation reduces the outstanding work, and any food slip adds an immediate pickup requirement.
states.old: A client has just arrived and still needs to place an order, and separately a prepared portion is being carried that must be delivered to a waiting client. Both the new client's order and the pending serve remain outstanding, and any slip of the carried food must be recovered on the very next step.

states.new: A client is waiting whose order has not been taken, and food has just slipped. The agent must pick the food up on the very next step or fail irreversibly. After a successful pickup, the client's still-untaken order remains the objective, followed by preparation and serving.
states.old: A client has just arrived and the food has just slipped out of the hands, with an order already taken by that client. The food must be picked up on the immediately next step, then prepared and served to the waiting client.

states.new: A waiting client's order is untaken, prepared food awaits serving, and food has just slipped. The agent must recover the fallen food on the very next step; otherwise the immediate-pickup requirement fails irreversibly. After a successful pickup, both the order-taking and serving obligations remain.
states.old: A client has just arrived and the food has just slipped out of the hands, while food had already been prepared for a waiting client. The fallen food must be retrieved on the very next step, then delivered; both the new client's order and the pending serve remain.

states.new: An order has been taken and still needs preparation, while a client is also waiting whose order has not yet been taken. Both duties are pending: prepare food for the taken order and take the waiting client's order. A food slip adds an immediate next-step pickup requirement on top of these obligations.
states.old: A new client has arrived and still needs to have their order taken, while an earlier order already has food prepared and awaiting delivery. The new order must be taken and the prepared portion served, with any slip recovered on the next step.

states.new: An order has been taken but not prepared, a client is waiting whose order is untaken, and food has just slipped. The agent must pick the food up on the very next step or fail irreversibly. After recovering it, the preparation and order-taking duties remain.
states.old: A new client has arrived and needs their order taken, and the food has just slipped from the hands while a previous order is outstanding. The fallen food must be picked up on the very next step, then prepared and served alongside handling the new client.

states.new: Prepared food is waiting to be served, and an order has been taken whose food still needs preparation. states.old: A prepared portion is being carried and must be delivered to the waiting client. Any slip of it must be answered by picking it up on the immediately next step; if it cannot be recovered then, the task can no longer succeed.

states.new: Prepared food awaits serving, an order awaits preparation, and food has just slipped. The very next step must restore food to the agent's hands, or the immediate-pickup requirement is failed irreversibly. After a successful pickup, the serving and preparation obligations remain.
states.old: Food has just slipped out of the hands while a prepared portion was still owed to a waiting client, and no order is currently taken. The food must be picked up on the very next step, then served; failing to regain it immediately makes success impossible.
